title: NATO and Russia: the first 24 hours of a conventional war, and the line it stops at

strikes.notes: Hour 0. Opening strike, conventional, simulation choice: Russia hits first, on the Polish air base nearest Kaliningrad, before NATO can use it against the oblast. Iskander-M is dual-capable, 350 to 500 km by source (A10); the shot is well inside 350 km. Base location is public.
Hour 0.5. Conventional strike on the Canadian-led Latvian battlegroup base (A7). Simulation choice; base location is public.

strikes.launch_name: Baltic Fleet corvette, Baltic Sea (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Hour 1. Ship-launched cruise missile (A11 stock estimates are Ukrainian and not used as a salvo size). Kalibr range is not in research.md: the script does not state it.

Hour 4. Conventional only: CSIS does not confirm a nuclear Oreshnik, and the 2026 Lviv use appears to have carried inert warheads (A13). Deployed in eastern Belarus from December 2025 (A13); launch site simulated. Rzeszow is the hub for aid to Ukraine (A9).

strikes.launch_name: NATO strike aircraft over northern Poland (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Hour 5. NATO suppression of Kaliningrad air defence and airfields, the likely first target per Western officers (A3, single-source). US role is a simulation choice informed by A16 and A23. Missile type generic; no range or stock claimed.

strikes.launch_name: NATO strike aircraft over the Baltic Sea (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Hour 6. Baltiysk is the Baltic Fleet's main base (A26). Simulation choice.

strikes.launch_name: NATO strike aircraft over northern Poland (location simulated)
strikes.notes: Hour 6.5. A dense belt of S-400 air defence (A12, A26); exact sites are not in open reporting, so the point is simulated.

strikes.target_name: Bemowo Piskie training area, Poland (US battalion group)
strikes.notes: Hour 13. Conventional strike on the forward US battalion group near the Suwalki approach (A8, single-source). Simulation choice.

strikes.target_name: Open Baltic Sea, away from any coast (warning shot, location simulated)
strikes.notes: Hour 22 (t0). One nuclear warning shot over empty water, no ship or coast targeted. Iskander is dual-capable (A10, A17); no open source gives its yield, so 10 kt is a SIMULATION CHOICE, about half of Nagasaki's 21 kt (ep 002 B8). Airburst.
